item.title: Version 1.5.0
item.description:
Apps stay in the VPN

VPNonly now remembers which apps belong in the VPN. Quit an app and open it again — from the Dock, Spotlight, anywhere — and it goes back into the tunnel on its own. Before, quitting an app quietly took it out.

Never lost in the menu bar

If your menu bar is full and macOS hides the shield, VPNonly now opens in a window with a Dock icon instead of looking like it failed to launch.

Updates install themselves

From this version on, updates download and install in one click, with no re-approving the app.
